observations.fields: SYSTEM / LUID 0x3e7; cmd.exe spawned by WmiPrvSE.exe PID 0x980; net user svc_dirsync ... /add /domain
SYSTEM / LUID 0x3e7; cmd.exe spawned by WmiPrvSE.exe PID 0x980; net group Domain Admins svc_dirsync /add /domain
svc_dirsync added to Domain Admins by SYSTEM / LUID 0x3e7

interpretation: The visible SMB rows correlate with separate type-3 SMB logons, not the WmiPrvSE command execution identity. The Security events establish local SYSTEM ownership but no remote initiator. The authored scenario models these actions as SYSTEM-origin actions and does not assert a remote WMI source. No impossible ordering or source-native contradiction was established, so this remains an attribution/collection gap rather than a confirmed defect.
decision: No generation or scenario change; carry as contextual finding for fresh panel.
